coder_notes: Single-group phase 3 with two registered cohorts; temozolomide (arm 1) and lomustine (arm 2) are the background chemotherapy per cohort and are not the question, so soc_backbone. Arm 1 label says 'Newly diagnosed or Recurrent' but eligibility requires recurrence. Secondary outcome text mentions tofacitinib 5 mg while arms say 10 mg (registry inconsistency).
